summary.zh: 按准开头只是开始，还要把输入保持到指定终点。
summary.en: Hitting the start is only the beginning: keep the input held through the required span.

rules.zh: 长音标出开始和持续区段，玩家到点按下后必须维持对应输入。过早松开会丢失后续判定或收益；若同时出现别的提示，还要在保持长按的同时处理它。结束时是否另判一次松手，应由具体规则明确。
rules.en: A sustained note marks a start and a duration. Press at its start and keep the required input held; releasing early loses later judgments or rewards. Other prompts may need attention during the hold. Whether release timing receives its own judgment must be specified by the implementation.

loop.en: Read the note’s start and length
Press on time and keep holding

loop.zh: 兼顾长音期间的新提示
loop.en: Handle new prompts during the hold

loop.zh: 结束长音并准备下一个输入
loop.en: Finish the hold and prepare the next input

decisions.zh: 长音还没结束时，怎样分配手指去处理另一条输入？
decisions.en: How should you allocate fingers to another input before the hold ends?

decisions.zh: 两个输入来不及兼顾时，要保住正在持续的长音，还是提前松开争取下一次命中？
decisions.en: If you cannot manage both inputs, keep the current hold or release early to attempt the next hit?

effect.zh: 更长会占用手指更久，只有搭配清楚的节奏变化才不容易变成单纯等待。
effect.en: Longer holds occupy an input longer; clear rhythmic changes keep them from becoming empty waiting.

effect.zh: 加入另一轨的短音能测试协调；应逐步增加，避免第一次就要求复杂指法。
effect.en: Short notes on another lane test coordination; introduce them gradually before demanding complex finger patterns.

effect.zh: 只要求按够时长更易理解；额外判定松手时刻会增加一个独立的精准操作。
effect.en: Requiring sufficient duration is simpler; judging release timing adds a separate precision demand.

implementation.zh: 谱面包含需要持续保持的长音；开发者说明部分长音末端还有松手提示，更高难度也会引入节拍键长按。
implementation.en: Charts include hold notes. The developer explains that some hold endings include lift-off cues, with beat-button holds introduced at a higher difficulty.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：音符轨道、转盘、连击与得分可见；此图不能证明长按从开始到结束的判定。
observation.en: System reference: the note track, wheel, combo and score are visible; this still cannot establish a hold from start to release.

implementation.zh: 谱面有上下轨长音，玩家保持对应输入；部分段落还要求在持续长音时击退其他敌人，形成一边按住、一边处理短音的协调。
implementation.en: Upper and lower lanes contain hold notes. Some passages also require hitting enemies during a hold, combining sustained input with separate short actions.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：战斗画面、连击数和生命状态可见；本图没有展示长按音符的完整持续区段。
observation.en: System reference: combat, combo count and health are visible; the complete hold-note interval is not depicted.

contrast.zh: Spin Rhythm XD 可进一步检查长音末端的松手；Muse Dash 的典型变化是持续长音时还要处理另一组攻击。
contrast.en: Spin Rhythm XD can add a release cue at the hold ending; Muse Dash highlights handling other attacks while a hold continues.

combination.zh: 组合提案：用长按维持蒸汽阀门四拍，再在出锅窗口松手；另一口锅的提示穿插其中，形成保持与切换的取舍。
combination.en: Design proposal: hold a steam valve for four beats and release within a cooking window while another pot inserts prompts, testing when to sustain or switch inputs.

setup.zh: 教学示例：左键长音持续四拍，第三拍另有一次右键短音。
setup.en: Teaching example: a left-key hold lasts four beats, with a right-key tap on beat three.

action.zh: 玩家左手一直按住，第三拍用右手点一下。
action.en: The player keeps the left input held and taps with the right hand on beat three.

result.zh: 长音的持续段被完整点亮，右侧短音也获得命中反馈。
result.en: The held segment fills completely and the right-side note also registers a hit.

next.zh: 下一组长音换到右键，需要提前调整两手分工。
next.en: The next hold moves to the right key, requiring a new division between the hands.

firstStep.zh: 只做两个键、四个长音和两个穿插短音；显示长音起止以及保持是否中断。
firstStep.en: Use two keys, four holds and two interleaved taps; show hold boundaries and whether input was interrupted.

pitfall.zh: 只在起点判定会让长按变成装饰；每帧乱扣分又会让一次误松被重复惩罚。
pitfall.en: Judging only the start makes the hold cosmetic; repeated penalties every frame can overpunish one accidental release.

test.zh: 玩家能否指出自己是开头没按准，还是中途松开导致丢分？
test.en: Can players tell whether lost credit came from a mistimed start or an early release?
